lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Large high-luminance circular blobs are arranged in approximately four irregular vertical columns posterior to the gill region, forming a staggered grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (light gray) intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, with several major centroids positioned directly within these vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition with light on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gills contains a dense population of high-frequency, small-diameter luminance spots that contrast with the larger, more sparse blobs on the lateral flank.
